subject.title: [Bug]: opencode-go works via direct infer but fails in embedded agent runtime with session takeover

question: What proof is sufficient to close this provider-specific OpenCode Go embedded-runtime issue after the generic session-takeover recovery work lands?
rationale: The current source confirms the takeover path still exists, the closest recovery PR is broad and unmerged, and only maintainers can decide whether generic organic-takeover proof is enough or whether this exact provider flow needs live validation.

options.title: Require OpenCode Go live validation
options.body: Keep this issue open until direct inference, first embedded turn, follow-up turn, and tool-call turn are proven with `opencode-go/mimo-v2.5`.

options.title: Accept generic recovery proof after merge
options.body: Close this issue after the broader recovery PR lands if maintainers decide its organic takeover proof covers OpenCode Go sufficiently.

recommendation.title: Require OpenCode Go live validation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until direct inference, first embedded turn, follow-up turn, and tool-call turn are proven with `opencode-go/mimo-v2.5`.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is centered on embedded session-lock ownership behavior, and the older feature-history commit for that ownership surface is the strongest non-rename provenance signal.
